No observed GP-MP-C advantage over matched white GP-MP does not assign all STMP-to-GP-MP-C gains to neural architecture. STMP differs in denoiser parameterization, variance-estimation method, damping and query-variance update. The main SNR comparison shares basic minimum/maximum iterations and tolerance, while GP-MP-C additionally checks the variance-update residual. Account for paired uncertainty and retain unfavorable results.
